close.note: Implementation and local certification are complete; no commit, push, release, installation, or consumer change was performed.
close.summary: Implemented and certified fail-closed integrity recovery across warrant validation, remediation replay, and overlay publication.
recommendations: Before delivery, stage only the integrity-recovery changes after reconciling them with the pre-existing staged worktree changes.
learnings: Approval digests must authenticate the exact executable payload and warrants must be resolved before creating a new plan.
Replay must distinguish the physical close checkpoint from the effective remediation-chain state to remain idempotent across retries and later evolution.

beforeClose.title: Integrity recovery without a new public surface
beforeClose.objective: Make integrity repair approval, replay, resume, and checkpoint overlays fail-closed without adding a public command.
successCriteria: An approved digest authenticates the exact executable warrant payload.
Retrying the same digest preserves remediation records, anchors, and Doctor PASS.
A valid remediation chain can accept a later delta with continuous base and result digests.
Tampered warrants and overlays fail without writes.
Portable adversarial tests and the complete Kyro gate pass.

requirements.statement: Integrity apply must authenticate the persisted warrant and resolve it before preparing new state.
requirements.rationale: Human approval must bind exactly the operations that execute.

requirements.statement: Remediation replay must expose the effective chain state so retries are idempotent and later deltas continue the chain.
requirements.rationale: Rebasing every record on the close image creates duplicate or divergent records.

requirements.statement: Canonicalization apply must reject any invalid matching overlay or broken overlay chain.
requirements.rationale: Invalid evidence must never be treated as absent and replaced.

requirements.statement: Regression tests must verify artifact invariance and Doctor after every retry frontier.
requirements.rationale: Exit code alone did not detect a corrupted remediation chain.

requirements.statement: The implementation must retain six public commands, one agent, and version 4.47.0 metadata without delivery actions.
requirements.rationale: This is integrity hardening, not a public-surface expansion or release.

scenarios.when: an operation is altered without changing the approved digest
scenarios.then: apply fails DIVERGED and writes nothing

scenarios.when: the same integrity digest is applied again
scenarios.then: the existing record and sprint bytes remain unchanged and Doctor passes

scenarios.given: a valid R-001 chain and a later live delta
scenarios.when: the delta is prepared and applied
scenarios.then: R-002 starts from R-001 result and Doctor passes

scenarios.given: a matching overlay whose committed content was altered
scenarios.then: apply fails and publishes no replacement overlay

nonGoals: Add a seventh slash command or a new root CLI verb.
Modify, install, release, commit, push, or publish the NutriLens consumer.
Rewrite immutable checkpoint, snapshot, or narrative bytes.

roadmap.sizingRationale: One focused sprint covers the five review blockers and their adversarial certification.

activeSprint.title: Fail-closed integrity recovery
activeSprint.objective: Close the five blocking findings from the independent integrity-recovery review.

phases.title: Transactional integrity hardening
phases.objective: Bind approval to executable bytes and make recovery replay idempotent and continuous.

tasks.title: Authenticate warrant payload
tasks.description: Use one canonical approval payload for prepare, warrant validation, trace routing, and apply.
tasks.context: Stored operations could be changed without invalidating the approved digest.
acceptance_criteria: A modified warrant fails DIVERGED and writes nothing.
Apply resolves a valid warrant before running prepare.

evidence.summary: Bound the executable warrant payload to the approved digest and made trace routing warrant-first.

checked_criteria: A modified warrant fails DIVERGED and writes nothing.
Apply resolves a valid warrant before running prepare.

tasks.title: Make remediation replay idempotent
tasks.description: Replay the existing chain as the baseline, reuse applied or prepared records, and append later deltas continuously.
tasks.context: Retry created R-002 based on the close image and made Doctor diverge.
acceptance_criteria: Same-digest retry keeps exactly one record and Doctor PASS.
A later delta creates R-002 whose base equals R-001 result.

evidence.summary: Replayed anchored remediations into an effective baseline, reused applied/prepared batches, and continued later deltas from the previous result.
evidence.validation: check-repair-integrity same-digest, prepared-resume, and R-002 continuity cases

checked_criteria: Same-digest retry keeps exactly one record and Doctor PASS.
A later delta creates R-002 whose base equals R-001 result.

tasks.title: Reject invalid overlay chains
tasks.description: Inspect raw overlay candidates and verify every newly published overlay before success.
tasks.context: A tampered overlay was treated as absent and replaced by another invalid record.
acceptance_criteria: Apply refuses a tampered matching overlay.
No additional overlay is written after tampering.

evidence.summary: Made canonicalization inspect raw candidates and the complete chain, then verify every published overlay before success.

checked_criteria: Apply refuses a tampered matching overlay.
No additional overlay is written after tampering.

tasks.title: Certify adversarial recovery
tasks.description: Expand portable tests to assert record count, byte invariance, prepared resume, later deltas, and Doctor postconditions.
tasks.context: The prior suite passed while the resulting chain was DIVERGED.
acceptance_criteria: The dedicated integrity check covers all four scenarios.

evidence.summary: Expanded portable adversarial certification to cover warrant tampering, same-digest byte invariance, prepared resume, continuous R-002, overlay tampering, and Doctor postconditions.

checked_criteria: The dedicated integrity check covers all four scenarios.

definitionOfDone: Doctor, status, and context-pack accept the reconstructed scope.
The complete npm check, diff check, and package dry-run pass.
